reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that adds a configurable right-side widget rail for session metrics, context and task status, usage visualization, and OpenCode Go quota monitoring.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可配置的右侧组件栏，用于展示会话指标、上下文与任务状态、使用情况以及 OpenCode Go 配额。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable right-side widget rail to DeepSeek Harness for session metrics, context and task status, usage visualizations, and OpenCode Go quota monitoring.

capabilities: Adds a customizable right-side widget rail to the conversation interface
Reads and displays session statistics, context usage, task counts, tokens, and usage history
Uses configured credentials through a same-origin proxy to retrieve OpenCode Go usage data
